patterns.title: Answer with verified facts and explicit gaps
useWhen: the answer includes Minecraft authoring facts for a target version
the answer summarizes generated files or code
the answer uses bundled, cached, or downloaded minecraft-skills data
requiredSections: target version or explicit latest-bundled assumption
verified facts with the data surface or tool that verified each fact
gaps or assumptions that remain unverified
final output requirements that were applied
evidenceStatements: State whether the evidence came from bundled data, cached/downloaded data, or a stated gap.
Name the exact fact surface when it affects interpretation, such as command paths, observed JSON shapes, vanilla paths, or Paper API surface.
Use claim policy wording when a surface has non-guarantees.
gapStatements: The available data does not verify this for the requested version.
This surface proves name or path presence only; it does not prove runtime behavior.
I am treating the target as the latest bundled version because no version was specified.
mustAvoid: presenting missing data as a likely fact
claiming support for another version without a comparison
copying upstream prose from Minecraft Wiki, Paper docs, or Javadocs
patterns.failureMode: A response can sound authoritative while hiding version assumptions or unsupported claims.

patterns.title: Answer when requested evidence is missing or unsupported
useWhen: preflight reports coverage unknowns or unsupported Paper
a search returns no command path, vanilla path, JSON field, type, member, or event candidate
a required downloadable surface is not available locally
requiredSections: the requested fact that could not be verified
the exact lookup or surface that failed to verify it
whether a downloadable surface may fill the gap
a safe alternative or a request for target-version/source clarification when available
evidenceStatements: Use the failed lookup name and target version instead of general uncertainty.
For unsupported Paper versions, state that bundled Paper support does not mark the version supported.
For missing downloadable data, point to data-manifest or fetch-data instead of guessing.
gapStatements: The checked surface did not verify that fact for this target version.
Do not generate this as verified until the missing surface is fetched or another source verifies it.
The latest Java release and latest supported Paper version differ in the bundled support matrix.
mustAvoid: inventing syntax, paths, events, types, or members from naming convention
emitting Paper dependency coordinates for an unsupported version
patterns.failureMode: An AI may fill missing evidence with plausible Minecraft knowledge that is wrong for the target version.

patterns.title: Answer about datapack command syntax
useWhen: the answer discusses command parser paths
the answer migrates command syntax between versions
requiredSections: target Java version
command path search or comparison result
statement that command path evidence proves parser shape only
remaining gameplay, permission, or runtime assumptions
evidenceStatements: Reference commands, compare-commands, or server-reports results.
When migrating, distinguish added and removed parser paths.
gapStatements: The command path surface did not verify that command form.
Parser-path presence does not guarantee runtime success.
This command still needs in-game behavior testing if behavior matters.
mustAvoid: claiming a command will succeed at runtime because a parser path exists
assuming command syntax from a nearby release
omitting the target version for generated commands
patterns.failureMode: Generated datapack functions can contain target-version-invalid or behavior-overstated commands.

patterns.title: Answer about resource pack assets, models, or item definitions
useWhen: the answer references vanilla asset paths
the answer writes model or item definition JSON
the answer explains resource pack migration
requiredSections: target Java version
resource pack format evidence when pack.mcmeta is included
vanilla asset path search or comparison evidence
observed-only wording for model or item definition shapes
evidenceStatements: Reference vanilla-paths or compare-vanilla-paths for paths.
Reference resourcepack-models or search-models for observed model and item definition shapes.
Use resourcepack-model-field-shape and vanilla-path-exists claim policy wording.
gapStatements: The path inventory did not find that vanilla asset for this target version.

The model summary does not prove every accepted key.

claiming rendering behavior from path presence
presenting observed client files as a complete resource pack schema
patterns.failureMode: Generated resource packs can reference missing assets or overstate observed client data.

patterns.title: Answer about Paper API, events, or scheduler-sensitive code
useWhen: the answer includes Paper plugin code
the answer names Paper, Bukkit, or Adventure types or members
the answer discusses events, scheduling, async work, worlds, entities, chunks, or Folia
requiredSections: target Paper-supported Minecraft version or support gap
Paper API reference or support metadata for dependency coordinates
Javadocs type/member evidence for referenced API names
threading, scheduler, Folia, behavior, or nullability assumptions that remain unproven
evidenceStatements: Reference paper, paper-api, paper-api-surface, paper-types, paper-members, or paper-events results.
Treat event search results as candidates until the event type is verified against the API surface.
Use paper-type-or-member-exists, paper-event-candidate, and folia-or-thread-safety claim policy wording.
gapStatements: The Javadocs search index proves name presence, not behavior, nullability, or thread safety.

inventing listener event classes or method names
claiming Folia safety from type/member presence alone
patterns.failureMode: Generated Paper plugins can target unsupported versions, invented API names, or unsafe threading assumptions.
